name: Brand board from any website with MiroMiro

parameters.content:
## Brand board from any website with MiroMiro

### How it works
Open a link in your browser and get a designed brand board for any website: logo, brand colors with their roles, the full palette, fonts, and how sure MiroMiro is. **Open Brand Board in Browser** is a webhook that takes the site from `?url=`. **Extract Brand Kit** reads the brand, **Draw Brand Board Page** turns it into an HTML page, and **Send Page to Browser** returns it. If the address has no `?url=` or the site cannot be read, the page says why instead of failing. Failed calls are not charged.

### Setup
This template uses the verified community node **n8n-nodes-miromiro** (tested with version 0.1.4 on n8n 1.123).
1. On n8n Cloud, search "MiroMiro" in the nodes panel (an admin may need to turn on Verified Community Nodes). Self-hosted: Settings > Community nodes > Install `n8n-nodes-miromiro`, see https://docs.n8n.io/integrations/community-nodes/installation/
2. Get a free MiroMiro API key (300 credits a month, no card): https://miromiro.app/api/onboarding
3. Open **Extract Brand Kit** > Credential > Create new, and paste the key.
4. Activate the workflow.
5. Open `<your n8n URL>/webhook/brand-board?url=stripe.com` in a browser.

Each new website costs 10 credits. The same site again within 24 hours is free.

### Customization
Change the colors and layout in the HTML inside **Draw Brand Board Page**. Change the webhook path to share a nicer link. Add a Google Drive node to save each board as an .html file.

![The workflow, in case the preview does not load](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SoraiaBarroso/n8n-nodes-miromiro/main/docs/templates/brand-board.png)

## Open the board

Activate the workflow, then open its URL with `?url=` and any website.

## Read and draw

MiroMiro reads the brand; the Code node draws the page and sends it back to the browser.
